title: Discarding/Swallowing Errors
pattern: Ignoring a returned `Result` or catching an exception with an empty block, bypassing error logging or propagation.
why_bad: When things go wrong, swallowing the error masks structural failures (like out-of-disk space, access denied, or corrupted databases), leaving the application in an unpredictable, untriagable state [28:433].
detection: Using `let _ = ...` or matching on `Err(_)` with an empty action block on functions that return I/O or database results [28:433].
fix: Always log, report, or propagate errors. Never let failures pass silently [28:433].
